mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may reduce renal perfusion and increase tolterodine levels via CYP2D6 inhibition and reduced renal clearance, while tolterodine's anticholinergic effects may worsen NSAID-related GI and renal risks.
action: Monitor renal function and tolterodine efficacy/adverse effects; consider alternative antimuscarinic or NSAID if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration.
